description: Critical Reading Code Reference for HVAC Monitoring System. Each numeric code maps to a specific fault type, severity, and affected component category.

288.label: High Discharge Temperature
288.description: Compressor discharge temperature exceeds safe operating threshold (>80°C). Risk of refrigerant breakdown and compressor seizure.
288.recommended_action: Immediate shutdown and inspection. Check condenser performance, refrigerant charge, and expansion valve.

301.label: Low Oil Pressure
301.description: Compressor oil pressure dropped below minimum safe level (<260 kPa). Bearing damage imminent.
301.recommended_action: Stop compressor immediately. Check oil level, oil filter, and oil pump.

315.label: Excessive Vibration
315.description: Compressor vibration exceeds safe threshold (>4.5 mm/s). Potential mechanical failure.
315.recommended_action: Schedule emergency maintenance. Inspect bearings, coupling alignment, and mounting bolts.

420.label: Condenser Fan Failure
420.description: One or more condenser fans have stopped operating. Heat rejection capacity severely reduced.
420.recommended_action: Replace failed fan motor. Check wiring, contactors, and thermal overloads.

435.label: High Approach Temperature
435.description: Condenser approach temperature exceeds 5°C above design. Fouling or airflow restriction suspected.
435.recommended_action: Clean condenser coils, check fan operation, verify airflow path is unobstructed.

442.label: Low Condenser Water Flow
442.description: Condenser water flow rate dropped below minimum requirement. Overheating risk.
442.recommended_action: Check condenser water pump, strainer, and isolation valves.

510.label: Evaporator Flow Switch Open
510.description: Chilled water flow has stopped or dropped below minimum threshold. Freeze risk on evaporator tubes.
510.recommended_action: Check chilled water pump, flow switch calibration, and piping for blockage.

525.label: Low Leaving Water Temperature
525.description: Leaving chilled water temperature below setpoint by >2°C. Potential freeze condition.
525.recommended_action: Check load conditions, capacity staging, and temperature sensor calibration.

538.label: Evaporator Pump Trip
538.description: Primary chilled water pump has tripped on overload or fault.
538.recommended_action: Reset pump, check motor windings, verify electrical supply.

610.label: Low Superheat
610.description: Superheat has dropped below 3°C. Risk of liquid refrigerant slugging the compressor.
610.recommended_action: Check expansion valve controller, verify sensor placement, inspect valve actuator.

625.label: Stuck Expansion Valve
625.description: Electronic expansion valve is not responding to control signals. Refrigerant flow unregulated.
625.recommended_action: Cycle valve power, replace stepper motor if unresponsive, check controller board.

640.label: High Subcooling
640.description: Subcooling exceeds 12°C indicating possible valve restriction or overcharge.
640.recommended_action: Verify refrigerant charge, check valve position, inspect for blockage.

CRITICAL.description: Immediate attention required. Equipment damage or safety risk.

WARNING.description: Degraded performance. Schedule maintenance within 24-48 hours.

INFO.description: Informational alert. Monitor trend over next few days.

needs_check.label: Needs Check
needs_check.description: Equipment healthy but showing early signs of degradation. Schedule preventive check.

warning.label: Warning
warning.description: Equipment performance degraded. Maintenance required soon.

critical.label: Critical
critical.description: Equipment in critical condition. Immediate maintenance required.
